_comment: Copy to time_sync.json (gitignored — it holds admin passwords).
tolerance_seconds: how far a clock may drift before it counts as wrong.
The node's `clock` reply only has minute resolution, so a correctly-set
node can read up to 59s behind. Keep this above 60.
reply_timeout: seconds to wait for an admin CLI reply over the mesh.
Each node needs the advertised name (or a pubkey prefix) and the admin
password. set_time=true lets the script push the correct time; with
Note: firmware refuses to move a clock backwards, so a node running
AHEAD cannot be fixed over the mesh and needs a power cycle.
Metrics (battery, temperature, radio counters) are logged for every node
listed here. Telemetry needs no login, so a node with no password and
set_time=false is graphed without its clock being touched.
_discovery: metrics_for_known_nodes: also sample every node the relay has discovered
(from seen_nodes.json), without listing it here. Telemetry needs no
login, so this graphs nodes you don't administer. Clocks are never
touched this way — only nodes listed below can be corrected.
metrics_node_types: which discovered types to sample. Default REP+ROOM;
adding CLI will sample every handheld that has ever advertised.

nodes.name: Ridge Repeater (metrics only, no admin password)
